definitions.explanation: Suffix indicating a type of vehicle or car.

examples.japanese: ⟦{貨物|かもつ}{車|しゃ}→貨物車：24767_kamotsusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}いでいる→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧。
examples.english: A freight truck is blocking the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転|じてん}{車|しゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{新|しん}{車|しゃ}→新車：11334_shinsha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

notes:
{車|しゃ} is a suffix used in compound words related to vehicles.

COMPOUNDS:

General vehicles:
- ⟦{自動|じどう}{車|しゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧: automobile
- ⟦{自転|じてん}{車|しゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧: bicycle
- ⟦{電|でん}{車|しゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧: train (electric)
- ⟦{汽|き}{車|しゃ}→汽車：01381_kisha⟧: steam train

Train cars:
- ⟦{貨物|かもつ}{車|しゃ}→貨物車：24767_kamotsusha⟧: freight car/truck
- ⟦{寝台|しんだい}{車|しゃ}→寝台車：23844_shindaisha⟧: sleeping car
- ⟦{食堂|しょくどう}{車|しゃ}→食堂車：23784_shokudousha⟧: dining car

Car conditions:
- ⟦{新|しん}{車|しゃ}→新車：11334_shinsha⟧: new car
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}{車|しゃ}→中古車：25939_chuukosha⟧: used car
- ⟦{外|がい}{車|しゃ}→外車：19013_gaisha⟧: foreign car
- ⟦{国産|こくさん}{車|しゃ}→国産車：23865_kokusansha⟧: domestic car

USAGE:
As a standalone word, ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ is used to mean "car." The reading {車|しゃ} appears primarily in compound words.
